answer: PoA binds each identity to bonded collateral, making equivocation provable across a quill-signed bridge transcript. For k coordinated identities, pairwise correlated penalties grow as k(k−1)/2, or O(k²); asymmetric depreciation compounds forfeiture so detection imposes an exponential multiplier in capital loss on a sybil swarm. Splitting stake therefore increases exposure rather than creating cheap voting power, keeping consensus on a ledge of accountability.
